blind_scene.selection: first fixed-Y candidate that is valid and unseen from the start

main.reason: all mandated same-XY main scenes fail the 30 mm goal-clearance rule

blind.planner_reuse: one warmed planner; camera_obstacle pose and CuboidData dimensions updated in-place each cycle

known_limits: all perceived points fit into one cuboid, so separate obstacles merge
all points at z <= 0.012 m are deleted, including a cable
robot pixels use simulator shape indices unavailable to a real camera
planner_truth_rule: truth used only by case B and offline scoring, never C/D/E input
worker_exchange: persistent Newton subprocess, JSON pipe plus temporary NPZ captures

playback_root_cause.cause: clearance_series returned shape [N,1]; playback formatted the one-element ndarray with +.4f, raising TypeError inside an uncaught daemon thread
playback_root_cause.reproduced_exception: TypeError: unsupported format string passed to numpy.ndarray.__format__
playback_root_cause.fix: clearance_series now returns shape [N], formatting casts float, and the worker reports exceptions to stderr and the Playback error GUI field
